name: Three battery soil-moisture nodes
description: Three independent sensing nodes reporting to one base. Deliberately quantified at three: this is where an exclusive-allocation matcher earns its keep, since owning one suitable board satisfies none of it.

requires.note: one per node — resistive or capacitive probe

One per node: holds the probe at a repeatable depth so readings compare between nodes. 260 mm because shallower gives topsoil moisture, which tracks the last rain rather than the root zone. Deliberately taller than a common 250 mm gantry - it is the case where the machine, not the parts drawer, is what stops you.
